title: Sequence Alignment & Dynamic Programming
description: Global (Needleman-Wunsch), Local (Smith-Waterman), Affine Gap Penalties, Hirschberg Linear Space, Edit Distance, and Multiple Sequence Alignment.

title: Genome Assembly & Graph Algorithms
description: De Bruijn graphs, Eulerian paths & cycles, Overlap graphs, k-mer composition, and paired-read de novo genome assembly.

title: Regulatory Motif Discovery
description: Median string search, Greedy motif search with pseudocounts, Randomized motif search, and Gibbs sampling algorithms.

title: Phylogenetic Tree Reconstruction
description: Additive phylogeny, UPGMA, Neighbor-Joining, Small & Large Parsimony, Newick format parsing, and tree distances.

title: Hidden Markov Models & Profile HMMs
description: Viterbi decoding algorithm, Forward-Backward probability evaluation, Baum-Welch parameter learning, and Profile HMMs.

title: String Indexing & FM-Index
description: Prefix Tries, Suffix Trees, Suffix Arrays, Burrows-Wheeler Transform (BWT), and Last-First (LF) mapping search.

title: Peptide Sequencing & Mass Spectrometry
description: De novo mass spectrometry sequencing, cyclopeptide scoring, spectral convolution, and spectral dictionary generation.

title: Genome Rearrangements & Synteny
description: Breakpoint graphs, 2-break genome operations, reversal distance estimation, and synteny block sorting.

title: Clustering & Unsupervised Learning
description: Lloyd's k-means clustering, Farthest First Traversal, Soft k-means Expectation-Maximization, and Hierarchical clustering.

title: Population Genetics & Combinatorics
description: Mendelian inheritance, Wright-Fisher genetic drift, RNA secondary structure Catalan numbers, and allele frequencies.

title: Classical Graph & Sorting Algorithms
description: Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, 2-Satisfiability (2-SAT), Strongly Connected Components, Topological sort, Quick/Merge sort.

title: Bioinformatics Armory & Tools
description: Production bioinformatic workflows using Biopython, FASTQ quality score filtration, GenBank API querying, and BLAST.

title: Python Village Foundations
description: Foundational Python syntax, string slicing, hash map counters, file I/O, and algorithmic building blocks.
